terms.gloss: spread out, open out (of a country, a plain)
evidence: Liv. 2.31: dum sē cornua lātius pandunt, while the wings spread wider (Lewis & Short s.v. pandō)
Plin. NH 6.38: ubi mare coepit in lātitūdinem pandī (Lewis & Short)
Cic. N.D. 2.135: partēs eae, quae sunt īnfrā, dīlātantur (Lewis & Short)
terms.comment: Traupman prints dīlatāre; Lewis & Short marks both vowels long, dīlātō (from differō, dīlātum).

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency.
Lewis & Short: pando
